title: KineBench: Benchmarking Embodied World Models via IDM-Free Kinematic Grounding
summary: Evaluating the physical consistency of embodied world models(EWMs) is a critical open challenge. While closed-loop evaluation via simulator rollouts offers a more faithful assessment of physical plausibility than open-loop alternatives, existing frameworks almost exclusively rely on Inverse Dynamics Models(IDMs) for action extraction. Due to the intricate mapping from 2D pixel space to 3D kinematic space, the learned IDMs can be brittle to data outside their training distribution, resulting in unreliable action extraction from the generated videos with novel objects and scenarios. This creates an unavoidable attribution ambiguity between world model inaccuracies and extractor errors. To reduce this ambiguity, we present KineBench, an IDM-free closed-loop benchmark for EWMs, built upon an explicit kinematic grounding pipeline. Given a generated video, KineBench employs cascaded visual foundation models to directly extract 6D end-effector poses from individual frames, which are then executed in a physics simulator for closed-loop validation. Beyond execution-based task success, KineBench incorporates two classical 3D kinematic metrics--Spectral Arc Length (SPARC) and the Maruyama Manipulability Index--to characterize trajectory smoothness and kinematic feasibility from a robot-centric perspective. Built on 20 diverse manipulation tasks in ManiSkill3, KineBench evaluates EWMs across four progressive suites: basic execution, task transfer, visual out-of-distribution generalization, and complexity-conditioned scaling. Evaluation across frontier models reveals task-complexity-bounded nonlinear scaling in embodied video generation, providing empirical guidance for future data-scaling strategies.
tldr: KineBench is an IDM-free closed-loop benchmark for embodied world models that uses visual foundation models to directly extract 6D end-effector poses for kinematic grounding, enabling evaluation of physical consistency without the attribution ambiguity of learned inverse dynamics models.
tldr_zh: KineBench 是一种无需逆动力学模型的闭环基准测试，用于评估具身世界模型，通过视觉基础模型直接从视频中提取6D末端执行器位姿进行运动学建图，消除了学习型逆动力学模型带来的归因模糊性。
summary_zh: 评估具身世界模型（EWM）的物理一致性是一项关键未决挑战。尽管通过模拟器展开进行闭环评估比开环方案能更可靠地评估物理合理性，但现有框架几乎完全依赖逆动力学模型（IDM）进行动作提取。由于从二维像素空间到三维运动空间的映射错综复杂，学习得到的IDM面对训练分布外的数据可能表现脆弱，导致从包含新颖物体和场景的生成视频中提取动作不可靠。这就在世界模型不准确性与提取器误差之间产生了不可避免的归因模糊性。为降低这种模糊性，我们提出KineBench——一种无需IDM的EWM闭环基准测试，它建立在显式运动学级联管道之上。给定生成视频后，KineBench利用级联视觉基础模型直接从单帧图像中提取6维末端执行器位姿，随后在物理模拟器中执行以实现闭环验证。除基于执行的任务成功外，KineBench还引入两种经典的三维运动学指标——频谱弧长（SPARC）和丸山可操纵性指数——从机器人中心视角刻画轨迹平滑度与运动学可行性。基于ManiSkill3中20个多样化操作任务，KineBench通过四个递进测试套件评估EWM：基础执行、任务迁移、视觉分布外泛化以及复杂度条件扩展。对前沿模型的评估揭示了具身视频生成中存在任务复杂度约束的非线性扩展规律，为未来数据扩展策略提供了实证指导。

title: Defer to Plan: Adaptive Multi-Agent Fusion for End-to-End V2X Driving
summary: Vehicle-to-everything-aided autonomous driving (V2X-AD) significantly enhances driving performance through information sharing. However, existing collaborative perception methods only optimize module-level perception capabilities and fail to effectively serve the ultimate planning and control tasks. We propose an end-to-end collaborative driving system that directly optimizes planning task performance. The system employs MotionNetwork to fuse historical temporal information, utilizes attention mechanisms to efficiently compress spatial features into compact tokens, and adaptively fuses multi-agent features through an autoregressive decoder. Additionally, we introduce Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture to enhance the model's representation capacity for heterogeneous features. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves a driving score of 79.72, surpassing the state-of-the-art CoDriving baseline (77.15) by 3.33% in closed-loop evaluation while maintaining communication efficiency.
tldr: This paper proposes an end-to-end collaborative driving system for V2X scenarios that fuses multi-agent features via attention, autoregressive decoding, and a Mixture-of-Experts architecture to directly optimize planning performance, achieving state-of-the-art closed-loop driving scores.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于V2X场景的端到端协同驾驶系统，通过注意力机制、自回归解码和混合专家架构融合多智能体特征，直接优化规划性能，在闭环评估中实现了最先进的驾驶分数。
summary_zh: 车联网辅助自动驾驶（V2X-AD）通过信息共享显著提升驾驶性能。然而，现有协同感知方法仅优化模块级感知能力，未能有效服务于最终的规划与控制任务。我们提出一种直接优化规划任务性能的端到端协同驾驶系统。该系统采用MotionNetwork融合历史时序信息，利用注意力机制将空间特征高效压缩为紧凑令牌，并通过自回归解码器自适应融合多智能体特征。此外，我们引入混合专家（MoE）架构以增强模型对异质特征的表示能力。实验表明，本方法在闭环评估中实现驾驶得分79.72，超越当前最优的CoDriving基线（77.15）3.33%，同时保持通信效率。

title: PerceptDrive: Perception Prior World-Action Modeling with Adaptive Expert Routing for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Frozen perception foundation models encode rich geometric, semantic, and dynamic knowledge. Yet narrow conditioning interfaces may attenuate task-relevant cues, while static fusion cannot adjust expert contributions to each scene. We cast this challenge as the prior-to-plan transfer problem and introduce PerceptDrive, a perception prior world-action modeling framework with adaptive expert routing. PerceptDrive feeds teacher-distilled priors from a frozen, driving-adapted provider and dense observation latents from a frozen self-supervised video encoder into a trainable expert-routed world-action model. Expert-specific query branches process these signals, while a prior-retention objective anchors each branch to its prior. A router predicts soft gates from a shared scene representation and combines the expert conditions before trajectory generation. During training, privileged rule-based sub-metric estimates for branch-specific trajectory drafts provide soft-gate distillation targets. The predicted action-free future latent conditions a flow-matching actor. At inference, privileged components are absent; with one front-facing camera, PerceptDrive generates one trajectory per planning step without test-time scoring, reranking, or search. Experiments show that PerceptDrive achieves state-of-the-art performance with 90.4 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.2 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, outperforming existing methods. Ablations confirm complementary gains from prior retention and scene-conditioned routing, alongside differential reliance on the three priors. These results demonstrate that preserving and adaptively routing perception priors improves direct planning without test-time candidate selection.
tldr: PerceptDrive introduces a perception prior world-action modeling framework with adaptive expert routing for end-to-end autonomous driving, achieving state-of-the-art planning performance on NAVSIM benchmarks.
tldr_zh: PerceptDrive提出了一种具有自适应专家路由的感知先验世界-动作建模框架，用于端到端自动驾驶，在NAVSIM基准测试中达到了最先进的规划性能。
summary_zh: 冻结感知基础模型编码了丰富的几何、语义和动态知识。然而，狭窄的条件接口可能会削弱任务相关线索，而静态融合无法根据每个场景调整专家贡献。我们将这一挑战定义为先验到规划的迁移问题，并提出了PerceptDrive——一种具有自适应专家路由的感知先验世界动作建模框架。PerceptDrive将从冻结的驾驶适配提供者中提取的教师蒸馏先验，以及从冻结的自监督视频编码器中提取的密集观测潜变量，输入到可训练的专家路由世界动作模型。专家特定查询分支处理这些信号，同时先验保持目标将每个分支锚定到其先验。路由器从共享场景表示中预测软门控，并在轨迹生成前组合专家条件。在训练过程中，针对分支特定轨迹草稿的特权基于规则子度量估计提供了软门控蒸馏目标。预测的无动作未来潜变量条件化了一个流匹配执行器。在推理时，特权组件被移除；仅使用一个前置摄像头，PerceptDrive在每个规划步骤生成一条轨迹，无需测试时评分、重新排序或搜索。实验表明，PerceptDrive在NAVSIM v1上达到90.4 PDMS，在NAVSIM v2上达到90.2 EPDMS，实现了最先进的性能。消融实验验证了先验保持和场景条件路由带来的互补增益，以及三个先验的差异化依赖。这些结果表明，保留并自适应路由感知先验能够改善直接规划，而无需测试时候选选择。

title: Closing the Lab-to-Store Gap: A Data-Efficient Post-Training and Experience-Driven Learning VLA Framework for Retail Humanoids
summary: Closing the gap between benchmark performance and reliable real-world operation remains a central challenge for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) humanoid robots, which must handle execution errors, distribution shifts, and environmental variability. This paper presents DEED (Data-Efficient Post-Training and Experience-Driven Learning), a systems-level approach evaluated on a supermarket chip-restocking task using a Unitree G1-Edu humanoid robot and the GR00T N1.6 foundation model. DEED comprises three key components: (1) a data-efficient post-training pipeline with control-frequency alignment, data curation, task-relevant visual highlighting, and reduced VLA dependence; (2) a real-world study of experience-driven refinement, adapted from RECAP via a text-based advantage prefix and a vision-language value function; and (3) a latent-space analysis tool for studying in- and out-of-distribution behavior. Our results suggest that bridging the lab-to-store gap is primarily a systems integration challenge rather than an architectural one: careful data design and targeted post-training can transform a policy that fails under naive fine-tuning into a competent real-world system using only a single GPU.
tldr: DEED presents a systems-level VLA framework for retail humanoid tasks, combining data-efficient post-training and experience-driven refinement to bridge the lab-to-store gap with minimal compute.
tldr_zh: DEED提出了一种面向零售人形机器人的系统级VLA框架，通过数据高效的后训练和经验驱动的细化，以最小计算量弥合实验室到商店的差距。
summary_zh: 缩小基准性能与可靠真实世界运行之间的差距，仍是视觉-语言-动作（VLA）人形机器人面临的核心挑战，这类机器人必须应对执行错误、分布偏移及环境变化。本文提出DEED（数据高效后训练与经验驱动学习），这是一种系统级方法，基于Unitree G1-Edu人形机器人与GR00T N1.6基础模型，在超市补货任务中进行了评估。DEED包含三个关键组件：（1）数据高效后训练流程，具备控制频率对齐、数据筛选、任务相关视觉高亮及降低VLA依赖等特性；（2）面向真实世界的经验驱动优化研究，通过基于文本的优势前缀及视觉-语言价值函数对RECAP方法进行改进；（3）用于分析分布内与分布外行为的潜在空间分析工具。研究结果表明，弥合实验室与门店之间的差距主要是一个系统集成挑战而非架构问题：通过精心设计数据并实施针对性后训练，仅需单块GPU即可将原本在朴素微调下失败的策略转化为胜任真实世界任务的系统。

title: SeededGrasp: Language-Guided Grasping in Complex Scenes with Multiple Embodiments
summary: Practical robotic grasping in complex scenes requires both 3D spatial reasoning and alignment with task-specific requirements. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer a natural way to specify these requirements using language, but existing approaches either use a VLM to predict the grasp directly with limited spatial awareness, or train the VLM together with the grasping model, which requires significantly more data and compute. These limitations impede performance and have prevented scaling to multiple embodiments in complex scenes. We address this by proposing SeededGrasp, a novel data-efficient framework that enables a VLM to predict a seed point to be used as conditioning for a subsequent lightweight grasp-generation model. Our architecture decouples high-level semantic reasoning from low-level geometric execution, enabling multi-embodiment support while bypassing the need for expensive end-to-end training. To enable training such models, we release the first multi-embodiment tabletop grasping dataset comprising over 2.5M grasps in cluttered scenes. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach outperforms existing baselines, achieving 72% success in simulation and 78% in real-world grasping experiments. See our project site for data and code: https://uoft-isl.github.io/seeded-grasp/
tldr: SeededGrasp decouples semantic reasoning (VLM predicts a seed point) from geometric grasp execution, enabling data-efficient, multi-embodiment language-guided grasping in cluttered scenes.
tldr_zh: SeededGrasp 将语义推理（VLM 预测种子点）与几何抓取执行解耦，实现了在杂乱场景中数据高效、多形态的语言引导抓取。
summary_zh: 在复杂场景中实现机器人抓取需要同时具备3D空间推理能力和对任务特定需求的理解。视觉语言模型（VLM）提供了一种通过语言指定这些需求的自然方式，但现有方法要么直接使用VLM预测抓取姿态而导致空间感知能力受限，要么将VLM与抓取模型联合训练，这需要显著更多的数据和计算资源。这些局限性阻碍了性能提升，并限制了在复杂场景中向多形态机器人扩展。为此，我们提出SeededGrasp——一种新颖的数据高效框架，使得VLM能够预测一个种子点，作为后续轻量级抓取生成模型的条件输入。我们的架构将高层语义推理与低层几何执行解耦，在避免昂贵端到端训练的同时，支持多形态机器人应用。为支持此类模型训练，我们发布了首个多形态桌面抓取数据集，包含杂乱场景中超过250万次抓取数据。实验结果表明，我们的方法优于现有基线，在仿真和实际抓取实验中分别达到72%和78%的成功率。数据和代码详见项目网站：https://uoft-isl.github.io/seeded-grasp/

title: ReferTrack: Referring Then Tracking for Embodied Visual Tracking
summary: Embodied visual tracking (EVT) requires a mobile agent to continuously follow a specific target described in natural language using only onboard vision. While recent vision-language-action (VLA) policies unify target identification and trajectory planning, their chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning often operates in abstract spatial latents that are difficult to supervise and weakly aligned with explicit image-space detections. To address this, we introduce ReferTrack, a referring-then-tracking paradigm that grounds EVT using a single forward-facing camera. Our model first selects the target from an indexed set of bounding boxes, then decodes tracking waypoints conditioned on this image-grounded decision. To preserve target motion cues over time, ReferTrack maintains a sliding-window queue of previously selected bounding boxes, injecting their geometric features into the visual history via temporal-viewpoint-bbox indicator (TVBI) tokens. We further enhance target identification by co-training on a custom Refer-QA dataset. On EVT-Bench, ReferTrack achieves state-of-the-art single-view performance with success rates of 89.4%, 73.3%, and 74.1% on the single-target, distracted, and ambiguity tracking splits, respectively -- matching or even surpassing several multi-camera baselines on identification-heavy tasks. Finally, real-world deployments on legged and humanoid robots validate its robust sim-to-real transfer capabilities. Code is available at https://github.com/MedlarTea/referTrack.
tldr: ReferTrack introduces a referring-then-tracking paradigm for embodied visual tracking, using a single forward-facing camera to select a target from bounding boxes and decode tracking waypoints, achieving state-of-the-art results on EVT-Bench and validated on legged and humanoid robots.
tldr_zh: ReferTrack 提出了一种先引用后跟踪的范式用于具身视觉跟踪，通过单目前向摄像头从边界框中选择目标并解码跟踪路径点，在 EVT-Bench 上取得最先进结果，并在足式和人形机器人上验证了其鲁棒的模拟到现实迁移能力。
summary_zh: 具身视觉追踪（EVT）要求移动智能体仅利用机载视觉持续追踪自然语言描述的特定目标。尽管近期视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略统一了目标识别与轨迹规划，但其思维链（CoT）推理常作用于难以监督的抽象空间隐变量，且与显式图像空间检测的对齐较弱。为此，我们提出ReferTrack——一种先指代后追踪的范式，利用单台前向相机实现具身视觉追踪。该模型首先从索引化的边界框集合中选择目标，随后基于图像锚定的决策解码追踪路径点。为保留时序目标运动线索，ReferTrack维护了先前选定边界框的滑动窗口队列，并通过时态-视点-边界框指示符（TVBI）令牌将几何特征注入视觉历史。我们进一步通过联合训练自定义Refer-QA数据集来增强目标识别能力。在EVT-Bench上，ReferTrack在单目标、干扰目标和模糊追踪子集上分别取得89.4%、73.3%和74.1%的成功率，达到单视角追踪的最优性能——在重识别任务上匹配甚至超越多个多相机基线方案。最后，在足式机器人和人形机器人上的实际部署验证了其鲁棒的仿真到现实迁移能力。代码已开源至https://github.com/MedlarTea/referTrack。

title: Robots Acquire Manipulation Skills in Seconds from a Single Human Video
summary: The ability to acquire skills rapidly and effortlessly while retaining those already mastered is essential for robots. However, current methods still rely on a cumbersome training-time loop that is costly and slow, while eroding skills already mastered. In this paper, we introduce HOST (Human-to-robot One-Shot Skill AcquisiTion), a framework that enables a robot to acquire skills in seconds from a single human video while retaining previously mastered skills. HOST resolves skill acquisition through a cascade of self-grounded prediction. It first estimates the robot's progress within the demonstrated task, then translates the upcoming progression into the robot's own future observations, and finally derives actions from these predicted observations. This cascade is trained on targets coupled to the video demonstration, obtained by mapping the robot trajectory and the video demonstration onto a shared task progress manifold, then redefining each target to align with the future progression of the video. HOST thereby enables the robot to actively follow the demonstrated procedure and adapt it to the robot's embodiment. HOST acquires novel skills at inference time from a single human video in an average of 29 seconds and achieves a 62% average success rate. It exceeds the zero-shot baseline by 45% while retaining previously mastered skills. HOST even exceeds the baseline fine-tuned on 50 robot demonstrations per task while requiring 50 times fewer demonstrations and acquiring each skill 507 times faster. Additional information about HOST is available on the project website.
tldr: HOST enables robots to acquire manipulation skills from a single human video in seconds via a cascade of self-grounded prediction that aligns human and robot task progress, achieving a 62% success rate while retaining prior skills.
tldr_zh: HOST使机器人能够通过级联自接地预测，从单个人类视频在几秒内获取操作技能，成功率达62%，同时保留已学技能。
summary_zh: 快速且轻松地获取新技能，同时保留已掌握技能的能力对机器人至关重要。然而，当前方法仍依赖于繁琐的训练时循环，该循环成本高昂且速度缓慢，同时会侵蚀已掌握的技能。本文提出HOST（人类到机器人的一次性技能获取）框架，该框架使机器人能够从单个人类视频中在数秒内获取技能，同时保留先前掌握的技能。HOST通过级联自基预测来解决技能获取问题：首先估计机器人在演示任务中的进度，然后将后续进度转化为机器人自身的未来观测，最后从这些预测的观测中推导出动作。该级联过程基于与视频演示耦合的目标进行训练，这些目标通过将机器人轨迹与视频演示映射到共享任务进度流形获得，再重新定义每个目标以使其与视频的未来进度对齐。由此，HOST使机器人能够主动遵循演示流程，并将其适配到机器人自身实体。HOST在推理阶段从单个视频中平均29秒内获取新技能，并达到62%的平均成功率。它超越零样本基线45%，同时保留已掌握技能。HOST甚至超越基于每任务50次机器人演示微调的基线，而所需演示次数减少50倍，技能获取速度提升507倍。关于HOST的更多信息可访问项目网站。

title: Diffusion ReRoll: Revisable Denoising for Robotic Sequential Prediction
summary: We propose Diffusion ReRoll, a diffusion-based framework for robotic sequential prediction that enables revisable denoising over horizons. Existing diffusion-based sequence predictors typically perform a single monotonic denoising process. In contrast, Diffusion ReRoll selectively re-noises regions that have become locally stable while the remaining regions continue denoising, so the re-noised regions can be refined again using context from the rest of the horizon. This structured re-noising enables iterative cross-horizon revision, allowing earlier and later segments to revise one another, while maintaining local consistency. We evaluate Diffusion ReRoll against full-sequence diffusion and causal denoising based on Diffusion Forcing across long-horizon planning, policy learning, and unified video-action modeling. On OGBench PointMaze and AntMaze, Diffusion ReRoll achieves relative gains in average success rate of 21% over Diffusion Forcing in matched guidance-based planning and 23% over Diffuser in matched goal-inpainting. In diffusion-policy-style action prediction, Diffusion ReRoll improves average success by 56.5% relative to Diffusion Policy across different prediction horizons and history lengths on the LIBERO-10 multi-task benchmark. In unified video-action prediction, Diffusion ReRoll improves policy and inverse dynamics performance, especially under out-of-distribution evaluation, and achieves the best action-video consistency. These results support structured re-noising as an effective mechanism for revisable robotic sequence generation.
tldr: Diffusion ReRoll introduces a revisable denoising framework for robotic sequential prediction that selectively re-noises locally stable regions to enable iterative cross-horizon refinement, achieving significant improvements in long-horizon planning, policy learning, and unified video-action modeling.
tldr_zh: Diffusion ReRoll 提出了一种可修订的去噪框架，用于机器人序列预测，通过选择性重新加噪局部稳定区域实现跨时域的迭代优化，在长时域规划、策略学习和统一视频-动作建模中取得了显著改进。
summary_zh: 我们提出扩散重滚动（Diffusion ReRoll），一种基于扩散的机器人序列预测框架，能够在时间跨度上实现可修正的去噪过程。现有基于扩散的序列预测器通常执行单一单调的去噪流程。相比之下，扩散重滚动选择性地对已局部稳定的区域重新加噪，同时其余区域继续去噪，从而使重新加噪的区域能够利用序列余下部分的上下文信息再次进行细化。这种结构化的重加噪机制实现了跨时间跨度的迭代修正，允许早期与后期片段相互修正，同时保持局部一致性。我们在长程规划、策略学习以及统一视频-动作建模任务中，将扩散重滚动与全序列扩散及基于扩散强制（Diffusion Forcing）的因果去噪方法进行了对比评估。在OGBench PointMaze和AntMaze上，扩散重滚动在匹配引导的规划任务中，平均成功率相对扩散强制提升21%；在匹配目标修复任务中，相对扩散器（Diffuser）提升23%。在扩散策略风格的动作预测中，扩散重滚动在LIBERO-10多任务基准上，针对不同预测跨度与历史长度，平均成功率相对扩散策略（Diffusion Policy）提升56.5%。在统一视频-动作预测任务中，扩散重滚动提升了策略与逆动力学性能（尤其在分布外评估场景下），并实现了最优的动作-视频一致性。这些结果验证了结构化重加噪作为机器人序列可修正生成的有效机制。

title: What Matters in Humanoid General Motion Tracking? An Empirical Study
summary: Humanoid general motion tracking requires policies that can follow diverse whole-body references while maintaining balance. Building such policies involves many practical design choices, and their individual effects are often hard to assess. We address this issue with an empirical study of common modeling and training factors used in recent humanoid motion-imitation pipelines. To make the study controlled and reproducible, we developed YAHMP, an open-source modular framework for training, evaluating, and deploying whole-body motion tracking policies on the Unitree G1. Within YAHMP, we define a nominal configuration and compare variants that differ in motion-command representation, observation history, action representation, actuation profile, hand-force randomization during training, and training approach. We evaluate the resulting policies on a test set of retargeted human motions and compare the nominal policy with TWIST2 as an external baseline trained on the same motion set. The results distinguish choices with clear tracking effects from choices that mainly change actuation effort, training complexity, or physical interaction capability. Finally, we deploy YAHMP policies zero-shot on the real Unitree G1, demonstrating diverse whole-body motion tracking, balance under external perturbations, and forceful interaction.
tldr: This paper presents YAHMP, an open-source framework for training and deploying whole-body motion tracking policies on the Unitree G1 humanoid, and conducts an empirical study comparing design choices such as motion representation, observation history, and training approach, with zero-shot deployment on a real robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了YAHMP，一个用于在Unitree G1人形机器人上训练和部署全身运动跟踪策略的开源框架，并通过实证研究比较了运动表示、观测历史和训练方法等设计选择，实现了在真实机器人上的零样本部署。
summary_zh: 仿人全身运动跟踪需要能够跟随多样化全身参考同时保持平衡的策略。构建此类策略涉及诸多实际设计选择，其各自影响往往难以评估。我们通过对近期仿人运动模仿流程中常见建模与训练因素的实证研究来解决这一问题。为实现受控且可重复的研究，我们开发了YAHMP——一个用于在Unitree G1平台上训练、评估和部署全身运动跟踪策略的开源模块化框架。在YAHMP框架内，我们定义了基准配置，并比较了在运动指令表征、观测历史、动作表征、驱动配置、训练时手部力随机化以及训练方法等方面存在差异的变体。我们在重定向人体运动测试集上评估所得策略，并将基准策略与在同一运动集上训练的外部基线TWIST2进行对比。研究结果区分了具有明确跟踪效果的选择与主要改变驱动力、训练复杂度或物理交互能力的选择。最终，我们在真实Unitree G1机器人上零样本部署YAHMP策略，展示了多样化全身运动跟踪、外部扰动下的平衡保持以及强力交互能力。

title: SOPD-SocialNav: Selective On-Policy Distillation for Vision-Language Social Navigation
summary: Vision-language models have shown strong potential for social robot navigation by leveraging rich semantic understanding of complex environments and human behaviors. However, large scale VLMs are difficult to deploy on resource-constrained robotic platforms, while lightweight VLMs often lack sufficient social reasoning capability. To address this problem, we propose SOPD-SocialNav, a selective on-policy distillation (SOPD) method that transfers social navigation knowledge from a large teacher VLM to a lightweight student VLM. SOPD introduces an entropy-based token selection mechanism that uses teacher uncertainty to identify socially informative decision tokens, while suppressing gradients from low-entropy tokens corresponding to trivial navigation states. A temperature-controlled Jensen-Shannon divergence objective is then used to align the student and teacher distributions on the selected tokens. Experiments on the SNEI and MUSON benchmarks demonstrate that SOPD consistently outperforms supervised fine-tuning, off-policy distillation, and standard on-policy distillation baselines in action prediction, perception consistency, and reasoning consistency. Real-world deployment on a Scout Mini robot further shows that the distilled model can generate more socially appropriate navigation behaviors in conversational and queuing scenarios. These results suggest that SOPD is an effective strategy for building lightweight yet socially aware VLM-based navigation systems.
tldr: SOPD-SocialNav proposes a selective on-policy distillation method to transfer social navigation knowledge from a large teacher VLM to a lightweight student VLM for vision-language social navigation, achieving competitive performance on benchmarks and real-world robots.
tldr_zh: SOPD-SocialNav 提出了一种选择性在线蒸馏方法，将大型教师 VLM 的社交导航知识迁移至轻量级学生 VLM，用于视觉语言社交导航，在基准测试和真实机器人上取得了有竞争力的表现。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型通过利用对复杂环境和人类行为的丰富语义理解，在社会机器人导航方面展现出强大潜力。然而，大规模视觉-语言模型难以在资源受限的机器人平台上部署，而轻量级视觉-语言模型又往往缺乏足够的社会推理能力。为解决这一问题，我们提出SOPD-SocialNav，一种选择性策略蒸馏方法，将社会导航知识从大型教师视觉-语言模型迁移至轻量级学生视觉-语言模型。SOPD引入基于熵的令牌选择机制，利用教师不确定性识别具有社会信息性的决策令牌，同时抑制与平凡导航状态对应的低熵令牌的梯度。随后采用温度控制的Jensen-Shannon散度目标函数，在所选令牌上对齐学生与教师分布。在SNEI和MUSON基准上的实验表明，SOPD在动作预测、感知一致性和推理一致性方面始终优于监督微调、非策略蒸馏和标准策略蒸馏基线。在Scout Mini机器人上的实际部署进一步证明，经蒸馏的模型能够在对话和排队场景中生成更具社会适应性的导航行为。这些结果表明，SOPD是构建轻量级且具备社会意识的视觉-语言模型导航系统的有效策略。

title: NavVerse: Benchmarking Indoor-to-Outdoor Embodied Navigation in Continuous Robot Simulation
summary: Robots deployed in delivery, campus, and emergency-response settings often need to navigate from buildings to streets within a single continuous episode. Existing benchmarks usually evaluate indoor and outdoor navigation separately, and many abstract away robot execution, leaving exit finding, boundary traversal, adaptation, and kinodynamic failures underexplored. We introduce NavVerse, a physics-enabled benchmark for indoor-to-outdoor embodied navigation. NavVerse contains 100 indoor scenes, 50 urban outdoor scenes, and 50 indoor-to-outdoor scenes, and 10,000 episodes spanning Object Navigation, Vision-and-Language Navigation, and Place Navigation tasks, where agents search for semantic points of interest such as restaurants or banks. Agents are evaluated through executable robot interfaces using task-success, path-efficiency, and safety metrics. Zero-shot experiments with RL, VLA, and modular baselines show that current agents remain far from solving cross-context navigation: end-to-end VLAs obtain the highest zero-shot success, while the modular method provides the strongest safety profile. PlaceNav further reveals a clear drop from outdoor to indoor-to-outdoor scenes, indicating that adaptation remains major bottleneck.
tldr: NavVerse introduces a physics-enabled benchmark for indoor-to-outdoor embodied navigation, evaluating agents on 100/50/50 scenes with 10,000 episodes and showing that current RL, VLA, and modular baselines struggle with cross-context navigation.
tldr_zh: NavVerse提出了一个支持物理引擎的室内到室外具身导航基准，包含100/50/50个场景和10,000个任务，实验表明现有RL、VLA和模块化基线在跨场景导航中表现不佳。
summary_zh: 在配送、校园及应急响应场景中部署的机器人通常需要在单次连续任务中完成从建筑物到街道的导航。现有基准测试通常分别评估室内与室外导航性能，且多数忽略机器人的实际执行过程，导致出口寻找、边界穿越、环境适应及运动动力学失效等问题尚未得到充分研究。为此，我们提出NavVerse——一个面向室内到室外具身导航的物理仿真基准测试平台。该平台包含100个室内场景、50个城市室外场景、50个室内到室外场景，以及覆盖目标导航、视觉与语言导航、地点导航三大任务的10,000个任务序列，智能体需在此过程中搜索餐厅、银行等语义兴趣点。通过可执行的机器人接口，采用任务成功率、路径效率与安全性指标对智能体进行评估。基于强化学习、视觉-语言-动作模型及模块化基线方法的零样本实验表明，现有智能体远未解决跨场景导航问题：端到端视觉-语言-动作模型取得最高零样本成功率，而模块化方法提供最强安全保障。地点导航任务进一步揭示从室外场景到室内-室外场景的性能显著下降，表明环境适应能力仍是主要瓶颈。

title: LENS: LLM-guided Environment Simplification for Planning and Control in Clutter
summary: Despite recent advances in general-purpose robotic manipulation, real-world multi-object clutter remains challenging to handle for today's prevalent approaches. The problem scales in complexity due to more objects and collisions, more unpredictable contact physics, distractors, and task ambiguity. Bridging this gap to real-world deployment requires effective scene abstractions; yet today, producing such abstractions requires extensive task-specific manual engineering, which does not scale. These abstractions are costly to generate and difficult to adjust or fine-tune. We instead propose a plug-and-play fix to automatically generate scene-specific, task-specific, adaptively updating abstractions on top of existing planning and control stacks. LLM-guided Environment Simplification (LENS) produces a de-cluttered abstracted scene representation by merging (e.g., stacked objects) or pruning (e.g., distant objects) scene entities in a closed loop in response to task progress. These dynamic, task-relevant abstractions are versatile and easy to use. In our experiments, we show that LENS improves classical planning, model-based control, and a vision-language-action model, across a diverse set of highly cluttered manipulation scenes. Project website: https://lens-2026.github.io/.
tldr: LENS uses LLMs to automatically generate task-specific, dynamically updating scene abstractions by pruning or merging objects in clutter, improving planning, control, and VLA model performance on real-world manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: LENS 利用大语言模型自动生成任务特定的、动态更新的场景抽象表示，通过裁剪或合并物体来提升在杂乱环境中规划、控制及 VLA 模型的表现。
summary_zh: 尽管通用机器人操控技术近期取得了进展，但当今主流方法在处理真实世界中杂乱多物体场景时仍面临挑战。随着物体数量增加、碰撞频发、接触物理不可预测、干扰物出现以及任务存在歧义，问题的复杂度呈指数级增长。弥合这一现实部署差距需要有效的场景抽象，但当前生成此类抽象需要大量特定任务的人工工程化处理，难以扩展。这些抽象不仅生成成本高昂，且难以调整或微调。为此，我们提出一种即插即用的解决方案，可在现有规划与控制栈之上自动生成自适应更新的、场景与任务专用的抽象表示。LLM引导的环境简化方法（LENS）通过闭环合并（如堆叠物体）或剪枝（如远处物体）场景实体以响应任务进展，从而生成去除杂乱信息的抽象场景表示。这些动态的、与任务相关的抽象具有高度通用性与易用性。实验表明，在多种高杂乱度操控场景中，LENS能有效提升经典规划、基于模型的控制以及视觉-语言-动作模型的性能。项目网站：https://lens-2026.github.io/。

title: Emergent Autonomous Drifting for Collision Avoidance in Real-World Winter Driving Scenarios
summary: Real-world collision avoidance is a core motivation for studying the dynamics and control of high sideslip drifting in vehicles, yet the practical benefit of such maneuvers has so far primarily been tested in scenarios explicitly engineered to require drifting. In this work, we explore the question of if and when drifting may be optimal for safety in real-world winter driving conditions. We present a drift-capable nonlinear model predictive control (MPC) system designed to handle scenarios grounded in crash fatality data and deploy the controller in a high fidelity simulator across road departure and oncoming vehicle collision avoidance scenarios. The controller naturally initiates and sustains drifting maneuvers to stay on the road when hitting a patch of ice on the rear axle and to avoid an oncoming vehicle that has slid into its lane. Comparisons with a benchmark electronic stability control (ESC) system demonstrate how a drift-capable controller can trade off stability for controllability to precisely maneuver through dangerous winter driving scenarios. A Monte Carlo study over random ice patches further shows that the drift-capable controller achieves lower median lane error than ESC across several speeds, while revealing that drifting emerges predominantly at higher speeds.
tldr: This paper presents a drift-capable nonlinear MPC system for collision avoidance in winter driving, showing that drifting emerges as an optimal strategy at higher speeds to maintain lane control on ice and avoid oncoming vehicles, outperforming standard ESC in Monte Carlo simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种具备漂移能力的非线性MPC系统，用于冬季驾驶中的碰撞避免，表明在较高速度下漂移在冰面车道保持和避让对向来车时自然涌现且优于标准ESC。
summary_zh: 现实场景中的碰撞规避是研究车辆高侧滑漂移动力学与控制的核心动因，但迄今为止，这种操作的实际效益主要在以漂移为明确设计目标的测试场景中得到验证。本研究探讨了在真实冬季驾驶条件下，漂移是否以及何时可能成为实现安全性的最优策略。我们提出了一种具备漂移能力的非线性模型预测控制（MPC）系统，该系统基于致命碰撞事故数据设计场景，并在高保真仿真器中部署控制器，用于应对道路偏离及对向来车碰撞规避场景。当后轴遭遇冰面或对向车辆滑入本车道时，该控制器会自动触发并维持漂移操作以保持车辆在道路内行驶。通过与基准电子稳定控制（ESC）系统的对比，展示了具备漂移能力的控制器如何在危险冬季驾驶场景中权衡稳定性与可控性，从而实现精准操控。针对随机冰面的蒙特卡洛研究进一步表明：在多种速度下，具备漂移能力的控制器比ESC系统获得更低的中位车道偏离误差，同时揭示漂移主要出现在较高速度工况。

title: ModPack: An Extensible Teleoperation Interface for Bimanual Mobile Manipulation
summary: Existing teleoperation systems are often tailored to specific robot hardware and task domains, limiting their scalability and adaptability. We present ModPack, a modular and extensible teleoperation system designed to support diverse robot embodiments and task requirements within a unified framework. At the core of ModPack is a self-contained wearable "backpack" that integrates onboard computation, power, communication, and data storage. Built on top of this shared interface, the system supports plug-and-play capability modules including joint-level teleoperation with haptic feedback, mobile manipulation, and active perception. Experiments across two distinct robot platforms and real-world mobile manipulation tasks demonstrate that ModPack provides a flexible and reusable framework for data collection and policy learning. To support future research, we open-source the complete hardware design and software stack. Project website: https://modpack-robotics.github.io/
tldr: ModPack is a modular, open-source teleoperation system with a wearable backpack interface that supports bimanual mobile manipulation across different robot platforms for data collection and policy learning.
tldr_zh: ModPack 是一个模块化、开源的遥操作系统，通过可穿戴背包接口支持不同机器人平台上的双臂移动操作，用于数据采集和策略学习。
summary_zh: 现有遥操作系统往往针对特定的机器人硬件和任务领域进行定制，这限制了其可扩展性和适应性。我们提出ModPack，一种模块化且可扩展的遥操作系统，旨在统一框架内支持多种机器人形态和任务需求。ModPack的核心是一个自包含的可穿戴"背包"，其集成了机载计算、供电、通信和数据存储功能。基于该共享接口，系统支持包括带触觉反馈的关节级遥操作、移动操作和主动感知在内的即插即用功能模块。在两个不同机器人平台及真实世界移动操作任务上的实验表明，ModPack为数据采集和策略学习提供了灵活可复用的框架。为支持未来研究，我们开源了完整的硬件设计和软件栈。项目网站：https://modpack-robotics.github.io/

title: Evolving Cache Schedules for Fast Diffusion Policy Inference
summary: Diffusion policies achieve strong visuomotor control by iteratively denoising action chunks, but repeated denoising makes real-time deployment computationally demanding. Cache-based methods reduce inference cost by reusing intermediate activations, but existing training-free schedules typically allocate computation uniformly across blocks, ignoring heterogeneous redundancy across blocks and leading to a suboptimal performance-efficiency trade-off. To bridge this gap, we introduce Evolving Cache Schedules (EVO), a training-free acceleration framework that globally schedules cache refreshes via evolutionary search. EVO represents each candidate as a complete schedule over the block-timestep lattice. Thus, redundant transformer computations during iterative denoising can be skipped through cache reuse while preserving closed-loop rollout performance. To make the search practical, EVO introduces redundancy-aware initialization, which seeds the population with promising schedules, and target-conditioned early stopping, which verifies and terminates once a desired performance target is reached. The offline-optimized schedule can be directly plugged into pretrained diffusion policies without retraining. Extensive manipulation benchmarks show that EVO preserves near-full performance while substantially reducing computation, achieving up to 8.05x action-generation speedup and reducing FLOPs from 15.77G to as low as 1.96G. Source code is available at https://github.com/pillom/EVO.
tldr: EVO introduces a training-free evolutionary search framework to globally optimize cache refresh schedules for diffusion policies, achieving significant speedup (up to 8.05x) with minimal performance loss on manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: EVO 提出了一种无需训练的进化搜索框架，用于全局优化扩散策略的缓存刷新调度，在操作基准测试中实现了高达 8.05 倍的加速，且性能损失极小。
summary_zh: 扩散策略通过迭代去噪动作块实现强大的视觉运动控制，但重复去噪过程使实时部署面临高计算需求。基于缓存的方案通过复用中间激活值降低推理成本，然而现有免训练调度通常在各模块间均匀分配计算资源，忽略了不同模块间的异构冗余特性，导致性能与效率的权衡次优。为解决这一差距，我们提出进化式缓存调度（EVO）——一种通过进化搜索全局规划缓存刷新策略的免训练加速框架。EVO将每个候选方案表示为模块-时间步网格上的完整调度，从而能在迭代去噪过程中通过缓存复用跳过冗余的Transformer计算，同时保持闭环部署性能。为使搜索切实可行，EVO引入冗余感知初始化机制（为种群注入高潜力调度方案）与目标条件早停策略（达到预期性能目标后即时验证终止）。经离线优化的调度可直接嵌入预训练扩散策略，无需重新训练。大量操作基准测试表明，EVO在保持近乎完整性能的同时大幅降低计算量，实现最高8.05倍动作生成加速，并将浮点运算量从15.77G降至1.96G。源代码已开源至https://github.com/pillom/EVO。

title: SafeGen: Goal-Conditioned Video Diffusion of Safety-Critical Scenarios for VLM-Based Autonomous Driving
summary: VLMs are increasingly deployed in AD systems, creating an urgent need for rigorous safety evaluation under rare yet safety-critical scenarios. Among these, interactions with vulnerable road users represent a major source of real-world failures. However, existing safety-critical scenario generation methods predominantly rely on simulator-based pipelines, which suffer from a substantial sim-to-real gap and often fail to capture realistic, diverse, and unforeseen human-vehicle interaction dynamics. We present SafeGen, a goal-conditioned diffusion framework for safety-critical scenario generation in VLMADs. Our key insight is to formulate scenario generation as a goal-conditioned diffusion process, where a predefined catastrophic end-state serves as a strong supervisory signal, guiding the generation of temporally coherent video trajectories that naturally evolve toward safety-critical outcomes. Building on this formulation, we introduce Context Grounded End State Reasoning, which leverages VLMs to analyze benign driving contexts and infer latent vulnerabilities in human-vehicle interactions, producing structured end-state specifications that induce high-risk scenarios. Conditioned on these targets, we further propose End State Conditioned Video Evolution, which grounds semantic threats into physically plausible visual dynamics. Specifically, we instantiate high-risk agents within the scene via depth-aware geometric projection, followed by boundary-conditioned diffusion to generate intermediate frames with consistent motion patterns and temporal coherence. Extensive experiments across 3 VLMADs demonstrate that SafeGen increases the Judge Overall Score, a metric using a VLM judge to evaluate VLMADs' understanding and decision-making, by 24.25% on average compared to SoTA baselines. Furthermore, fine-tuning a VLMAD improves performance in real-world driving scenes by an average of 15.9%.
tldr: SafeGen is a goal-conditioned diffusion framework that generates safety-critical video scenarios for vision-language model-based autonomous driving systems by reasoning about latent vulnerabilities in human-vehicle interactions and producing temporally coherent, physically plausible video trajectories toward catastrophic end-states.
tldr_zh: SafeGen是一个目标条件扩散框架，通过推理人车交互中的潜在脆弱性，生成向灾难性终态演变的、时间连续且物理合理的视频场景，用于视觉语言模型自动驾驶系统的安全评估。
summary_zh: VLMs正越来越多地部署于自动驾驶系统，这使得在罕见但安全关键的场景下进行严格安全评估的需求日益迫切。其中，与弱势道路使用者的交互是现实世界故障的主要来源。然而，现有安全关键场景生成方法主要依赖基于仿真器的流水线，存在显著的仿真到现实差距，且往往难以捕捉真实、多样且不可预见的人车交互动态。我们提出SafeGen——一个面向VLMAD中安全关键场景生成的目标条件扩散框架。其核心见解在于将场景生成建模为目标条件扩散过程：预定义的灾难性终态作为强监督信号，引导生成在时间上连贯的视频轨迹，使其自然演变为安全关键结局。基于这一公式，我们提出上下文锚定终态推理，利用VLMs分析良性驾驶语境并推断人车交互中的潜在脆弱性，生成结构化的终态规范以诱导高风险场景。以这些目标为条件，我们进一步提出终态条件视频演化，将语义威胁具象化为物理可行的视觉动态。具体而言，我们通过深度感知几何投影在场景中实例化高风险智能体，随后通过边界条件扩散生成具有一致运动模式与时间连贯性的中间帧。在三种VLMAD上的大量实验表明，与最先进基线相比，SafeGen将"裁判综合评分"（一种利用VLM裁判评估VLMAD理解与决策能力的指标）平均提升24.25%。此外，对VLMAD进行微调后，其在真实驾驶场景中的性能平均提升15.9%。

title: D3VL: Understanding Driving Scenes from 3D Time Series Data and Video with Language Models
summary: Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have triggered the development of end-to-end MLLMs for autonomous driving. However, the main emphasis to date has been for MLLMs using 2D images and videos. In contrast, this paper considers MLLM effectiveness using 3D sensors, particularly LiDAR and stereo cameras. LiDAR presents unique challenges to integration within an MLLM, largely because of data sparsity and lack of a grid structure for the data. For similar reasons, fusion of camera and LiDAR data within an MLLM pipeline is also uncommon. However, most autonomous systems rely on LiDAR-based sensing, and incorporating 3D data has been proven to improve performance in traditional 3D scene perception tasks. This paper presents D3VL, a novel MLLM framework that integrates 2D and 3D time-series data in a single but simple architecture. The model aims to answer questions involving traffic scene understanding and safety. D3VL shows an 11% improvement in the KITTI Question-Answering (QA) dataset compared to baseline methods in processing 2D and 3D time-series data. This paper further introduces the Waymo QA dataset extension, which assesses models' capabilities in processing 3D and time-series data under diverse driving conditions. D3VL implementation code and WaymoQA extension can be found on our supplemental website: https://automotivesafety-lvlm.github.io
tldr: D3VL integrates 2D and 3D time-series data (LiDAR, stereo) into a single multimodal LLM for driving scene QA, achieving 11% improvement on KITTI QA and introducing the Waymo QA dataset.
tldr_zh: D3VL将2D和3D时序数据（激光雷达、立体相机）整合到单一多模态大语言模型中，用于驾驶场景问答，在KITTI QA上取得11%的提升，并引入了Waymo QA数据集。
summary_zh: 近期，多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的进展推动了面向自动驾驶的端到端MLLMs的发展。然而，迄今为止的研究重点主要集中于使用二维图像与视频的MLLMs。相比之下，本文探讨了MLLMs在利用三维传感器（特别是激光雷达与立体相机）时的有效性。激光雷达因数据稀疏且缺乏网格结构，给其在MLLM中的集成带来了独特挑战。出于类似原因，将相机与激光雷达数据融合到MLLM流程中亦不常见。然而，大多数自动驾驶系统依赖基于激光雷达的感知，且已有研究表明，将三维数据纳入传统三维场景感知任务可提升性能。本文提出D3VL，一种新颖的MLLM框架，该框架以统一且简洁的架构融合二维与三维时序数据。该模型旨在解答涉及交通场景理解与安全性的问题。在处理二维与三维时序数据时，D3VL在KITTI问答（QA）数据集上相比基线方法实现了11%的性能提升。本文进一步引入Waymo QA数据集扩展，用于评估模型在不同驾驶条件下处理三维与时序数据的能力。D3VL的实现代码及WaymoQA扩展可访问我们的补充网站：https://automotivesafety-lvlm.github.io

title: Towards Miniature Humanoid Tele-Loco-Manipulation Using Virtual Reality and Reinforcement Learning
summary: Full-sized humanoid robot capabilities have grown exponentially in recent years, aiming towards general-purpose deployment in human environments. A popular control method used by manufacturers utilizes Virtual Reality for upper-body teleoperation and Reinforcement Learning for lower-body balance and locomotion control. As a result, a single remote operator can see, manipulate, and navigate about a real, distant physical environment. This powerful control stack is often relegated to expensive full-sized robots, many of which are inaccessible to the research community. Miniature humanoids are more prevalent, but employ less biomimicry in their design (e.g. fewer sensors, Degrees of Freedom, etc) and lack similar developments. This paper describes a compliant full-body telepresence control stack developed from the ground up for miniature humanoids. Framework experimentation on ROBOTIS OP3 hardware showcases walking at speeds up to 0.45 m/s independent of arm motions. Tele-loco-manipulation is demonstrated via a cube relocation experiment with an expert human operator. On average, the teleoperated system moved 2 different 40 g cubes within 10 mins, walking a total distance of 5 m. Overall, the developed system shows potential for miniature humanoid tele-loco-manipulation.
tldr: This paper presents a compliant full-body telepresence control stack for miniature humanoids, combining VR upper-body teleoperation with RL-based lower-body locomotion, and demonstrates tele-loco-manipulation on ROBOTIS OP3 hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于微型人形机器人的柔顺全身遥在控制栈，结合了VR上半身遥操作与基于强化学习的下半身运动控制，并在ROBOTIS OP3硬件上展示了遥操作-移动-操作能力。
summary_zh: 全尺寸人形机器人的能力近年来呈指数级增长，其目标是在人类环境中实现通用化部署。制造商常用的一种控制方法，利用虚拟现实实现上半身远程操作，并借助强化学习控制下半身平衡与运动。由此，单个远程操作员即可观察、操控并导航穿越真实而遥远的物理环境。这一强大的控制栈通常仅应用于昂贵的全尺寸机器人，其中许多对研究社区而言难以触及。迷你人形机器人更为普及，但其设计仿生程度较低（例如传感器更少、自由度更低等），且缺乏类似的技术进展。本文描述了一套从零开始为迷你人形机器人开发的柔性全身远程临场控制栈。基于ROBOTIS OP3硬件的框架实验展示了独立于手臂动作的行走速度，最高可达0.45米/秒。通过由专业人类操作员执行的立方体重定位实验，验证了远程运动-操控能力。平均而言，远程操作系统在10分钟内移动了2个不同的40克立方体，行走总距离达5米。总体而言，所开发的系统展示了迷你人形机器人在远程运动-操控方面的潜力。

title: Extreme-RGMT: Continual Learning of Highly Dynamic Skills for Robust Generalist Humanoid Control
summary: Humans can progressively acquire highly dynamic motor skills while preserving reliable everyday motor abilities. In contrast, existing humanoid controllers face a trade-off between generalist and specialist capabilities: generalist motion tracking policies struggle to reliably execute rare highly dynamic motions, whereas specialist training can degrade previously acquired behaviors. We introduce Extreme-RGMT, a two-stage continual learning framework for robust generalist humanoid control. The method first learns a generalist motion-tracking base policy from diverse multi-source motion data, then employs an asymmetric skill acquisition and capability consolidation mechanism to constrain policy drift on mastered motions while emphasizing difficult dynamic segments. To address the scarcity of highly dynamic motions, their high failure rates, and the resulting shortage of informative samples, Extreme-RGMT combines difficulty-aware sampling with advantage-prioritized trajectory resampling to emphasize critical segments. Experiments show that Extreme-RGMT achieves state-of-the-art generalist whole-body motion-tracking performance, including substantially improved completion of challenging highly dynamic motions. The resulting controller directly executes diverse unseen highly dynamic motions under fixed references and online inertial motion-capture inputs, advancing generalist whole-body motion-tracking controllers toward highly dynamic motor capabilities at the human-expert level.
tldr: A continual learning framework for humanoid control that combines generalist motion tracking with specialist acquisition of highly dynamic skills, achieving state-of-the-art whole-body motion-tracking performance.
tldr_zh: 一个用于人形机器人控制的持续学习框架，结合了通用运动跟踪与高动态技能的专业化获取，实现了最先进的全身运动跟踪性能。
summary_zh: 人类能够在逐步掌握高度动态运动技能的同时，保持可靠的日常运动能力。相比之下，现有人形机器人控制器面临通用能力与专用能力之间的权衡：通用的运动跟踪策略难以可靠执行罕见的高度动态运动，而专用训练则可能导致已习得行为的退化。我们提出Extreme-RGMT，一种面向鲁棒通用人形机器人控制的两阶段持续学习框架。该方法首先从多样化的多源运动数据中学习通用运动跟踪基础策略，随后采用非对称技能获取与能力保持机制，在约束已掌握运动策略漂移的同时，重点强化动态困难片段。针对高度动态运动稀缺性、高失败率及其导致的典型样本匮乏问题，Extreme-RGMT将难度感知采样与优势优先轨迹重采样相结合，以突出关键运动片段。实验表明，Extreme-RGMT在通用全身运动跟踪性能上达到最优水平，包括显著提升具有挑战性的高度动态运动的完成度。最终控制器可在固定参考轨迹与在线惯性运动捕捉输入条件下，直接执行多样化的未见高度动态运动，推动通用全身运动跟踪控制器向人类专家级别的高度动态运动能力迈进。

title: Unified Prediction and Planning via Conflict-Aware Disjoint Parameter Training
summary: Accurate motion prediction of surrounding agents and safe motion planning are two closely coupled key tasks for social robot navigation in crowded environments. Deploying these systems on resource-constrained edge devices necessitates compact, unified models that can perform both tasks simultaneously. However, within these compact shared encoders, recent unified models often overlook severe representational conflicts that arise from the distinct objectives of predicting neighbor behaviors versus ego-centric safety planning. To address this issue, we first identify the Skill Conflict$\unicode{x2014}$a phenomenon where overlapping parameter assignments cause distinct tasks to compete for the same weights, preventing the model from fully specializing in individual skills. To resolve this, we propose a novel model-merging-based framework, Disjoint Parameter Training (DPT). DPT mitigates performance degradation caused by Skill Conflict through distributed parameter learning, which separates the key parameter regions of each task while preserving their core capabilities prior to merging. In addition, we observe that sparse merging, which selectively integrates only the most influential parameters for each task rather than combining all task-specific parameters, yields optimal performance by preventing interference among adjacent features and concentrating representational capacity. DPT can be applied in parallel with a variety of merging methods. Evaluated on standard crowd navigation benchmarks (JRDB and JTA), our framework demonstrates superior performance, validating its versatility and effectiveness for safe, resource-efficient robot navigation.
tldr: Identifies skill conflict in shared-encoder robot navigation models and proposes a Disjoint Parameter Training (DPT) framework with sparse merging to resolve parameter competition, improving unified prediction and planning on edge devices.
tldr_zh: 该研究识别了共享编码器机器人导航模型中的技能冲突问题，提出了一种基于模型合并且结合稀疏合并的分散参数训练框架，以解决参数竞争，提升资源受限设备上联合预测与规划的性能。
summary_zh: 精准预测周围智能体的运动以及安全的运动规划，是拥挤环境中社交机器人导航的两个紧密耦合的关键任务。在资源受限的边缘设备上部署此类系统，需要能够同时执行这两项任务的紧凑统一模型。然而，在这些紧凑的共享编码器中，近期的一些统一模型常常忽略了因预测邻居行为与以自我为中心的安全规划这两个不同目标而引发的严重表征冲突。为解决此问题，我们首先识别出技能冲突这一现象——即重叠的参数分配导致不同任务竞争相同权重，使得模型无法专注于各个技能的专精化。为此，我们提出了一种基于模型融合的新颖框架——分离参数训练（DPT）。DPT通过分布式参数学习来缓解技能冲突导致的性能下降，在融合前将每个任务的关键参数区域分离，同时保留其核心能力。此外，我们观察到，稀疏融合（即仅为每个任务选择性整合最具影响力的参数，而非组合所有任务特定参数）通过防止相邻特征间的干扰并集中表征能力，实现了最优性能。DPT可与多种融合方法并行应用。在标准人群导航基准（JRDB和JTA）上的评估表明，我们的框架展现了优越的性能，验证了其在安全、资源高效的机器人导航中的通用性和有效性。

title: EA-Nav: Learning Safe Visual Navigation Policies with Embodiment Awareness
summary: Cross-embodiment navigation is a key challenge in embodied intelligence. Due to differences in embodiment, the same visual observation may imply different actions for different agents, making prediction ambiguous when relying solely on vision. Existing studies mainly rely on reinforcement learning, which requires large-scale interaction and careful reward design, making it difficult to support scalable pretraining and real-world adaptation. In contrast, imitation-learning-based approaches remain limited. To address these challenges, we propose an imitation-learning-based embodiment-aware navigation framework with a modular multi-stage design. In pretraining, we construct a cross-embodiment navigation dataset from Internet videos and introduce embodiment geometry as conditional tokens to reduce action ambiguity under the same observation. In fine-tuning, we design a multimodal information injection mechanism based on a decoupled architecture. Specifically, we design a trajectory augmentation strategy to generate high-risk samples, which are used to train spatial perception and risk-aware correction separately, thereby explicitly incorporating embodiment geometry for safe navigation. Experimental results show that the proposed method effectively improves navigation performance across different embodiment settings, demonstrating the effectiveness of incorporating embodiment geometry into embodied navigation.
tldr: An imitation-learning-based navigation framework that explicitly incorporates embodiment geometry as conditional tokens to reduce action ambiguity across different robot embodiments, with a trajectory augmentation strategy for safe navigation.
tldr_zh: 一种基于模仿学习的具身感知导航框架，通过将具身几何作为条件编码来减少跨本体观测下的动作歧义，并利用轨迹增强策略实现安全导航。
summary_zh: 跨具身导航是具身智能中的一项关键挑战。由于具身形态的差异，相同的视觉观察可能意味着不同智能体需采取不同动作，这使得仅依赖视觉进行预测时存在歧义。现有研究主要依赖强化学习，但该方法需要大规模交互和精细的奖励设计，难以支持可扩展的预训练和真实场景适应。相比之下，基于模仿学习的方法仍较为有限。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种基于模仿学习的具身感知导航框架，采用模块化多阶段设计。在预训练阶段，我们从互联网视频构建跨具身导航数据集，并引入具身几何结构作为条件标记，以减少相同观测下的动作歧义。在微调阶段，我们设计了一种基于解耦架构的多模态信息注入机制。具体而言，我们提出了一种轨迹增强策略以生成高风险样本，并分别用于训练空间感知与风险感知校正模块，从而显式地将具身几何结构融入安全导航。实验结果表明，所提方法能有效提升不同具身设置下的导航性能，验证了将具身几何结构引入具身导航的有效性。

title: V2F: Vision-Informed Grasp Force Prediction for Damage-Aware Robotic Handling of Date Fruits
summary: This paper presents a vision-informed grasp force prediction framework for robotic handling of date fruits. Addressing the dual challenge of high detachment forces and low bruise thresholds, we first conduct mechanical characterization on date samples to define a safe grasping envelope and quantify the relationship between fruit geometry and bioyield stress. In this work, we develop a Vision-to-Force (V2F) pipeline that combines computer vision-based segmentation, active-contour refinement, and geometric feature extraction with a physics-informed residual neural network that augments a Hertz contact equation. The resulting model maps non-contact visual descriptors and cultivar metadata to predict a safe grasp force with mean validation performance of $R^2 \approx 0.7$ across unseen cultivar groups, which is a good result given the inherent mechanical variability of biological tissue. Experimental validation using a gripper and load cell indicates that the predicted forces enable stable manipulation of different types of date fruits, with residual deformations below 1 mm and no observable damage. These results show that pre-emptive, vision-driven force estimation% can replace slow and potentially damaging tactile exploration , enabling safer robotic handling of fragile fruits.
tldr: Proposes a vision-to-force pipeline combining computer vision and a physics-informed neural network to predict safe grasp forces for robotic handling of date fruits, validated with real hardware.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种视觉到力预测管道，结合计算机视觉和物理信息神经网络，为机器人处理椰枣水果预测安全抓取力，并通过真实硬件验证。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种面向机器人抓取椰枣的视觉引导抓取力预测框架。针对高分离力与低损伤阈值这一双重挑战，我们首先对椰枣样本进行力学特性表征，以定义安全抓取包络，并量化水果几何形状与生物屈服应力之间的关系。本研究开发了一条视觉-力（V2F）处理管线，该管线结合了基于计算机视觉的分割、主动轮廓优化以及几何特征提取，并集成了一种融合赫兹接触方程的物理信息残差神经网络。所构建的模型将非接触式视觉描述符与品种元数据映射为安全抓取力预测，在未见过的品种组上平均验证性能达到\(R^2 \approx 0.7\)。考虑到生物组织固有的力学变异性，这一结果表现良好。使用夹爪与力传感器进行的实验验证表明，预测力能够实现对不同类型椰枣的稳定操作，残余变形低于1毫米，且未观察到可见损伤。这些结果表明，基于视觉的先验力估计能够替代缓慢且可能造成损伤的触觉探索，从而实现更安全的脆弱水果机器人抓取操作。

title: EgoRecovery: Acquiring Failure Recovery Ability Through Human Recovery Demonstration
summary: Robust embodied robots should be able to recover from failures and retry tasks in order to operate reliably in unstructured and noisy real-world environments. Achieving this capability requires training policies on data that captures recovery behaviors. However, collecting such data through robot teleoperation is difficult to scale, as it is time-consuming to induce diverse failure states, perform corrective actions, and reset the environment. This challenge is further exacerbated by the high diversity of failure modes, which demands substantially more recovery data than success demonstrations. In this work, we show that egocentric human data capturing failure recovery processes provides a scalable alternative. By efficiently arranging task-level failure configurations and recording short recovery segments, human operators can generate more than 10x as much valid recovery data per hour compared to robot teleoperation under our protocol. To address the embodiment gap between human and robot, we propose EgoRecovery, a co-training framework for learning recovery behavior, where human recovery demonstrations are aligned to a compact corrective-intent space shared with robot data, which captures the timing and magnitude of correction. Only a small number of robot recovery demonstrations are required to connect this intent to executable robot actions. At deployment, a learned recovery gate predicts when correction is needed from robot observations and activates the corrective intent only in recovery states. Experiments on real-world recovery tasks show that EgoRecovery improves success from failure starts over robot-only recovery, direct co-training with human recovery data, and direct intent-transfer baselines.
tldr: EgoRecovery uses egocentric human failure-recovery demonstrations to train robotic recovery policies, aligning human and robot data via a shared corrective-intent space to enable scalable robot recovery from failures.
tldr_zh: EgoRecovery利用以自我为中心的人类失败恢复示范来训练机器人的恢复策略，通过共享的纠正意图空间对齐人类与机器人数据，实现可扩展的机器人故障恢复。
summary_zh: 鲁棒的具身机器人应能够从失败中恢复并重试任务，从而在非结构化且充满噪声的真实环境中可靠运行。实现这一能力需要利用包含恢复行为的数据来训练策略。然而，通过机器人遥操作收集此类数据难以扩展，因为诱导多样化的失败状态、执行纠正动作以及重置环境非常耗时。由于失败模式的高度多样性，所需恢复数据量远超成功演示数据，这一挑战进一步加剧。在本工作中，我们证明利用以自我为中心的人类数据捕获失败恢复过程提供了一种可扩展的替代方案。通过高效编排任务级失败配置并记录短恢复片段，人类操作员在我们的协议下每小时可生成的有效恢复数据量是机器人遥操作的10倍以上。为解决人类与机器人之间的具身差异，我们提出EgoRecovery，一种用于学习恢复行为的协同训练框架，其中人类恢复演示被对齐到与机器人数据共享的紧凑纠正意图空间，该空间捕捉了纠正的时机与幅度。仅需少量机器人恢复演示即可将这一意图与可执行的机器人动作相连接。在部署时，学习得到的恢复门控器根据机器人观测预测何时需要纠正，并仅在恢复状态下激活纠正意图。在真实世界恢复任务上的实验表明，EgoRecovery在从失败状态开始的成功率上优于纯机器人恢复、直接与人类恢复数据协同训练以及直接意图迁移基线方法。

title: Koopman Dreamer: Spectrally Constrained Latent Dynamics for Stable World-Model Imagination
summary: Latent world models improve sample efficiency in continuous control by optimizing policies over imagined latent trajectories, but common neural transitions offer limited direct control over modal persistence and error accumulation in long rollouts. We propose Koopman Dreamer, a Dreamer-style world model with a spectrally constrained deterministic latent dynamics core. Its Koopman-inspired backbone uses two-dimensional rotation--scaling blocks with bounded radii to represent damping, rotation, and near-periodic modes. Linear and low-rank bilinear action terms capture global and state-dependent control effects, while stochastic-state modulation supplies local correction information. To reduce the mismatch between posterior-conditioned training and prior-only imagination, the model combines posterior-conditioned EMA teacher targets with one-step consistency, multi-step rollout, and open-loop observation-prediction objectives. We further derive a multi-step rollout-error bound that separates amplification by the spectral backbone and bilinear interaction from the additive effects of stochastic-state mismatch and modeling residuals, clarifying the trade-off between error attenuation and long-term information retention. Experimental results on proprioceptive continuous-control tasks from the DeepMind Control Suite and UAV-LiDAR autonomous navigation demonstrate that Koopman Dreamer improves the stability of long-horizon latent rollouts and achieves stronger closed-loop control performance on tasks that rely on high-quality multi-step imagination.
tldr: This paper proposes Koopman Dreamer, a world model with spectrally constrained latent dynamics that improves long-horizon rollout stability and control performance in continuous control and UAV-LiDAR autonomous navigation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Koopman Dreamer，一种具有谱约束潜在动力学的世界模型，在连续控制和无人机-激光雷达自主导航中改善了长时域展开的稳定性与控制性能。
summary_zh: 潜在世界模型通过优化想象潜轨迹上的策略来提高连续控制中的样本效率，但常见的神经转移对长程推演中的模态持续性和误差积累只能提供有限的控制。我们提出Koopman Dreamer，这是一种具有谱约束确定性潜动态核心的Dreamer风格世界模型。其基于Koopman的骨干网络采用二维旋转-缩放块，并带有有界半径来表示阻尼、旋转和近周期模态。线性和低秩双线性动作项捕获全局及状态相关的控制效应，而随机状态调制提供局部校正信息。为减少后验条件训练与仅有先验想象之间的失配，该模型将后验条件EMA教师目标与单步一致性、多步推演及开环观测预测目标相结合。我们进一步推导出一个多步推演误差界，该界限将谱骨干网络与双线性交互引起的放大效应与随机状态失配和建模残差的加性效应分离，阐明了误差衰减与长期信息保持之间的权衡。在来自DeepMind控制套件和无人机激光雷达自主导航的本体感知连续控制任务上的实验结果表明，Koopman Dreamer提高了长时域潜推演的稳定性，并在依赖高质量多步想象的任务上实现了更强的闭环控制性能。

title: Milo, a Fully Autonomous Indoor/Outdoor Robotic Guide Dog
summary: Many Blind and Low-Vision (BLV) people rely on guide dogs for moment-to-moment navigation, such as staying on path and avoiding obstacles and pedestrians. However, guide dogs are expensive to acquire and maintain (approximately \$50k USD plus ongoing costs), often involve long waiting lists, and have relatively short life expectancies. While robot guide dogs offer a promising alternative, existing approaches exploring this idea suffer from several drawbacks: They often lack the autonomy required for real-world deployment, relying on prior 3D scans of the environment, external computation, or limited awareness of the handler. In this work, we present Milo, the first open-source, low-cost (approximately \$2k USD) robotic guide dog platform capable of fulfilling the basic collaborative navigation role expected of a guide dog. Milo is fully autonomous, requiring no a priori knowledge of the environment, completely self-contained with all computation performed onboard, and suitable for both indoor and outdoor navigation while avoiding obstacles and pedestrians. Our system consists of a modified Unitree Go2 robot (equipped with onboard compute, sensors, and a handle), a perception stack combining voxel mapping with floor, obstacle, and pedestrian detection, and a navigation stack based on an obstacle-avoidance policy trained in a custom bird's-eye-view simulator. We evaluate Milo in real indoor and outdoor obstacle courses and compare it against a costmap-based baseline, demonstrating smoother navigation and fewer handler collisions. To maximize accessibility for BLV users, we release both the robot hardware instructions and the complete software stack as open source.
tldr: Milo is an open-source, low-cost robotic guide dog platform that autonomously performs indoor/outdoor navigation with obstacle and pedestrian avoidance, requiring no prior environment knowledge and running all computation onboard.
tldr_zh: Milo 是一个开源、低成本的机器人导盲犬平台，可自主完成室内外导航并避障避人，无需先验环境知识且完全机载计算。
summary_zh: 许多盲人和低视力（BLV）群体依赖导盲犬进行实时导航，例如沿路径行走、避开障碍物和行人。然而，导盲犬的获取和饲养成本高昂（约5万美元，另加持续开销），通常需要长时间排队等候，且预期寿命相对较短。虽然机器导盲犬提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但现有探索此思路的方法存在若干缺陷：它们往往缺乏实际部署所需的自主性，依赖环境的三维预先扫描、外部计算或对使用者的有限感知。在本研究中，我们提出Milo——首个开源、低成本（约2000美元）的机器导盲犬平台，能够实现导盲犬所期望的基本协作导航功能。Milo完全自主运行，无需环境先验知识，所有计算均在机载完成，且适用于室内外导航，同时能避开障碍物和行人。我们的系统包含经过改装的Unitree Go2机器人（搭载机载计算设备、传感器和手柄）、结合体素映射与地面、障碍物及行人检测的感知模块，以及基于在自研鸟瞰仿真器中训练的避障策略的导航模块。我们在真实室内外障碍场地对Milo进行评估，并与基于代价地图的基线方法对比，结果表明其导航更平滑且与使用者碰撞更少。为最大化BLV用户的可及性，我们将机器人硬件说明和完整软件栈以开源形式发布。

title: GaussianSeed: Hierarchical Gaussian Seeding for High-Resolution 3D Occupancy Prediction
summary: Vision-centric 3D occupancy prediction provides dense scene representations essential for autonomous driving and robotic navigation, yet existing methods struggle to scale to high voxel resolutions due to prohibitive computational costs. To address this, we introduce GaussianSeed, a progressive multi-scale Gaussian occupancy prediction framework that organizes primitives into a coarse-to-fine hierarchy. Benefiting from this hierarchical design, GaussianSeed effectively circumvents the memory bottlenecks inherent in dense representations, successfully scaling to a $0.1\text{m}$ spatial resolution while maintaining real-time inference capabilities. To comprehensively evaluate high-resolution geometric perception, we further construct TJScenes, a panoramic six-camera occupancy dataset with highly detailed $0.1\text{m}$ annotations. Extensive experiments on Occ3D-nuScenes and TJScenes demonstrate that GaussianSeed delivers the lowest latency among all evaluated methods while maintaining highly competitive accuracy, advancing the efficiency-quality frontier of high-resolution 3D occupancy prediction.
tldr: A hierarchical Gaussian seeding framework for high-resolution 3D occupancy prediction that achieves real-time inference at 0.1m resolution.
tldr_zh: 一种分层高斯播种框架，用于高分辨率3D占据预测，在0.1米分辨率下实现实时推理。
summary_zh: 以视觉为中心的3D占用预测能够提供自动驾驶和机器人导航所需的高密度场景表征，然而现有方法因计算成本过高而难以扩展至高体素分辨率。为解决这一问题，我们提出GaussianSeed——一种渐进式多尺度高斯占用预测框架，该框架将基元组织为从粗到细的层级结构。得益于这种分层设计，GaussianSeed有效规避了密集表征固有的内存瓶颈，成功将空间分辨率扩展至0.1米，同时保持实时推理能力。为全面评估高分辨率几何感知性能，我们进一步构建了TJScenes数据集——一个包含全景六摄像头占用数据且具备精细0.1米标注的数据集。在Occ3D-nuScenes和TJScenes上的大量实验表明，GaussianSeed在所有评估方法中实现了最低延迟，同时保持极具竞争力的精度，推动了高分辨率3D占用预测在效率与质量前沿上的发展。

title: LoRFT: Benchmarking Long-Range Vehicle Trajectory Reconstruction from Fixed Highway Cameras
summary: Long-range vehicle trajectories provide important spatio-temporal evidence for traffic safety analysis, autonomous driving evaluation, and data-driven traffic management, yet continuously recovering them from fixed highway cameras remains difficult. As vehicles recede into distant road regions, perspective compression and scale decay often fragment or prematurely terminate automatic tracklets, even when their continuation remains identifiable from motion consistency across neighboring frames. We formulate this problem as recovering the far-range continuation of a vehicle trajectory from a reliable near-field tracklet. We introduce LoRFT, to our knowledge the first open benchmark dedicated to long-range vehicle trajectory reconstruction from fixed highway cameras. LoRFT comprises 22 expressway surveillance scenes, 366,109 video frames, 6,601 manually verified trajectories, 2,694,889 bounding boxes, road-geometry annotations, scene-level splits, and evaluation scripts. We further propose Map-RSTNet, a map-aware residual sequence-to-sequence model that reconstructs distant trajectories in a road-geometry-aligned state space and dynamically refreshes local road geometry during decoding. On LoRFT, Map-RSTNet reduces ADE, FDE, and 5-second RMSE by 11.0%, 15.4%, and 10.5%, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline. These results demonstrate that road-geometry-aware reconstruction can extend usable trajectory records from existing fixed-camera infrastructure. LoRFT provides a reproducible testbed for long-range vehicle trajectory reconstruction.
tldr: LoRFT is a benchmark and method for reconstructing long-range vehicle trajectories from fixed highway cameras, using a map-aware model to extend tracklets into distant road regions.
tldr_zh: LoRFT 是一个从固定高速公路摄像头重建远距离车辆轨迹的基准和方法，利用地图感知模型将跟踪片段扩展到远处道路区域。
summary_zh: 远程车辆轨迹为交通安全分析、自动驾驶评估及数据驱动交通管理提供了重要的时空证据，然而从固定高速公路摄像头中持续重建这些轨迹仍存在困难。当车辆驶向远处道路区域时，透视压缩与尺度衰减常导致基于运动一致性可跨帧识别的自动轨迹片段断裂或过早终止。本文将该问题定义为：从可靠的近场轨迹片段中恢复车辆轨迹的远程延续部分。我们提出LoRFT——据我们所知，这是首个专用于固定高速公路摄像头远程车辆轨迹重建的公开基准。LoRFT包含22个高速公路监控场景、366,109帧视频、6,601条人工验证轨迹、2,694,889个边界框、道路几何标注、场景层级划分及评估脚本。我们进一步提出Map-RSTNet，一种地图感知的残差序列到序列模型，该模型在道路几何对齐的状态空间中重建远端轨迹，并在解码过程中动态刷新局部道路几何信息。在LoRFT上，Map-RSTNet相较于最强基线，分别将ADE、FDE和5秒RMSE降低了11.0%、15.4%和10.5%。这些结果表明，道路几何感知重建可扩展现有固定摄像头基础设施中可用的轨迹记录。LoRFT为远程车辆轨迹重建提供了可复现的测试平台。

title: WASABI: Whole-graph Assignment-based Stabilizer for lAne topology By Inter-frame tracking
summary: Autonomous driving requires understanding the road as a graph of drivable lanes and their connectivity, beyond the ego lane alone, to follow routes through intersections and reason about cross- and merging-traffic. Recent perception models infer such lane topology, i.e., lane segments together with their inter-lane connectivity (LCLC), from onboard sensors over a 360-degree BEV view. Due to neural perception's imperfections, their outputs retain structural instabilities such as missed detections, lost or incorrect LCLC, over-detection, and label flicker. This paper presents WASABI, a real-time post-processing pipeline that stabilizes lane topology outputs both within and across frames by treating lane segments and their LCLC connectivity as joint tracking targets, under onboard real-time constraints (10 Hz / 20 ms / up to 200 input lanes). The pipeline integrates segment tracking with connectivity, noise-robust topology-aware refinement, and a resource-constrained real-time design. On internal validation data (16 sequences), WASABI improves LCLC detection F1 from 0.834 to 0.948 (+0.114, +13.6%) and reduces centerline lateral error from 2.50 m to 0.95 m, while reducing detection false-positives by 24.6%. Temporal-stability metrics on the same data show LCLC toggle rate reduced by 63.3% and boundary-label flicker rate by 30.2%, confirming across-frame stabilization beyond per-frame accuracy.
tldr: WASABI stabilizes lane topology outputs in autonomous driving by jointly tracking lane segments and their connectivity across frames, significantly improving detection F1, reducing lateral error, and enhancing temporal stability.
tldr_zh: WASABI通过联合跟踪车道线段及其跨帧连接性来稳定自动驾驶中的车道拓扑输出，显著提高了检测F1，减少了横向误差并增强了时间稳定性。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
自动驾驶不仅需要理解自车道，还需将道路建模为可行驶车道及其连接关系的图结构，以实现路口路径规划、交叉车流与合流车流的推理。当前感知模型通过360度鸟瞰视角的车载传感器，推断此类车道拓扑结构，即车道段及其车道间连接关系。由于神经感知存在不完善性，其输出存在结构不稳定性，包括漏检、车道间连接丢失或错误、过检测以及标签闪烁。本文提出WASABI——一种实时后处理流水线，通过将车道段及其车道间连接视为联合跟踪目标，在车载实时约束条件（10 Hz / 20 ms / 最多处理200条输入车道）下，实现帧内与帧间车道拓扑输出的稳定化。该流水线集成了带连接性的段跟踪、抗噪的拓扑感知优化以及资源受限的实时化设计。在内部验证数据（16个序列）上，WASABI将车道间连接检测F1分数从0.834提升至0.948（提升0.114，增幅13.6%），中心线横向误差从2.50米降至0.95米，同时检测虚警率降低24.6%。相同数据的时间稳定性指标显示，车道间连接切换率降低63.3%，边界标签闪烁率降低30.2%，验证了其在帧间稳定性提升方面超越单帧精度改善的效果。

title: Distributed Motion Planning with Safety Guarantees for Self-Reconfiguring Robotic Boats
summary: Aquatic self-reconfigurable robots must assemble into desired shapes while ensuring safe interactions among multiple agents. This paper proposes a hybrid framework that combines distributed Model Predictive Control (MPC) with Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) for multi-agent shape formation and reconfiguration. Given a desired shape and target assignment, a distributed MPC scheme, solved via the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM), computes coordinated trajectories through local optimization and information exchange. To ensure safety in real time, distributed CBF-based filters are applied to enforce inter-agent collision avoidance. The proposed approach leverages the predictive capabilities of MPC to mitigate local minima, while CBFs provide formal safety guarantees despite the nonconvexity of the underlying optimization problem. Simulation results with up to 25 agents and experimental validation with four physical robots demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of the framework.
tldr: A hybrid distributed MPC-CBF framework for multi-agent shape formation and reconfiguration of aquatic self-reconfigurable robots, with real-robot validation.
tldr_zh: 一种结合分布式模型预测控制与屏障函数的混合框架，用于水上自重构机器人的多智能体形状形成与重构，并通过实物实验验证。
summary_zh: 水生自重构机器人需在确保多智能体安全交互的前提下组装成目标形状。本文提出一种混合框架，将分布式模型预测控制（MPC）与控制障碍函数（CBF）相结合，用于多智能体形状形成与重构。针对给定目标形状与任务分配，通过交替方向乘子法（ADMM）求解的分布式MPC方案，利用局部优化与信息交换计算协同轨迹。为确保实时安全性，采用基于分布式CBF的滤波器强制执行智能体间碰撞规避。该方法利用MPC的预测能力缓解局部极小值问题，同时尽管底层优化问题具有非凸性，CBF仍能提供形式化安全保障。基于最多25个智能体的仿真实验与四台实体机器人的验证结果，证明了该框架的有效性与可扩展性。

title: Morphing MILR: Design and control of a cable-driven limbless robot with rolling joints for maneuvering in complex environments
summary: Limbless robots offer exceptional mobility in confined and cluttered environments due to their slender bodies and their ability to exploit body-terrain interactions. Recent designs incorporating compliance demonstrate robust locomotion without complex sensing or control; however, these systems typically rely on fixed body configurations, with each morphology specialized for a single locomotion mode or environment. This raises a key challenge: how can a single limbless robot achieve versatile locomotion while preserving the robustness of compliance-mediated locomotion? To address this challenge, we present a cable-driven limbless robot that reconfigures body morphology and compliance to enable diverse locomotion modes. Distributed cable actuation generates traveling body waves, while programmable passive compliance enables robust contact-rich locomotion without terrain knowledge or high-bandwidth feedback. Rolling joints reorient bending planes along the body, enabling rapid reconfiguration and smooth transitions between locomotion styles, and incorporate geared locking to maintain configuration without continuous power. By combining programmable bending compliance and morphology control, the platform achieves lateral undulation, sidewinding, rolling, and twisting within a single system. Experiments demonstrate reliable gait generation, traversal in obstacle-rich environments, and transitions between modes, establishing a versatile limbless platform for navigating complex environments with applications in search and rescue, environmental monitoring, and inspection.
tldr: This paper presents a cable-driven limbless robot with rolling joints and programmable passive compliance that can reconfigure its body morphology to achieve versatile locomotion modes (lateral undulation, sidewinding, rolling, twisting) for navigating complex environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种采用滚动关节和可编程被动柔顺性的缆索驱动无肢机器人，通过重新配置身体形态实现多种运动模式（横向波状运动、侧向绕行、滚动、扭转），以在复杂环境中导航。
summary_zh: 无肢机器人在受限和杂乱环境中展现出卓越的移动能力，这得益于其细长体型以及利用身体与地形相互作用的能力。近期引入柔顺性的设计使其无需复杂感知或控制即可实现稳健运动；然而，这些系统通常依赖固定身体构型，每种形态专门适用于单一运动模式或环境。这引发了一个关键挑战：单个无肢机器人如何在保持柔顺介导运动鲁棒性的同时实现多功能运动？为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种缆索驱动的无肢机器人，通过重构身体形态与柔顺性实现多样化运动模式。分布式缆索驱动产生行进波，而可编程被动柔顺性使其无需地形知识或高带宽反馈即可实现鲁棒的接触密集运动。滚动关节可沿身体重定向弯曲平面，实现快速构型重构与运动风格间的平滑过渡，并集成齿轮锁定功能，无需持续供电即可维持构型。通过结合可编程弯曲柔顺性与形态控制，该平台在单一系统中实现了侧向蜿蜒、侧向绕行、滚动与扭转运动。实验验证了可靠步态生成、在障碍物密集环境中的通行能力以及模式间的切换，为复杂环境导航建立了一个多功能无肢平台，可应用于搜索救援、环境监测与检测等领域。

title: Learning Personalized Safety Interventions for Haptic Human-Robot Shared Control
summary: Haptic feedback provides an implicit channel for communicating safety intentions during human-robot shared control. Existing haptic guidance systems typically employ predefined intervention strategies that cannot accommodate the diverse safety preferences of individual users or application scenarios. To address this limitation, we propose a Learning from Haptics (LfH) framework that learns user-preferred safety interventions from sparse demonstrations, eliminating the need for manual trial-and-error design. Our framework is built on a differentiable Control Barrier Function (CBF)-based optimization layer that automatically adjusts the underlying safety parameters to match the demonstrated haptic responses. Instead of tuning controller parameters directly, users teach the system how they expect it to intervene during teleoperation. The resulting haptic guidance reflects the demonstrated intervention preferences while preserving the intuitive interaction of haptic shared control. Simulation and hardware experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework can learn personalized safety interventions from sparse user input and reduce the mismatch between the generated haptic feedback and the demonstrated preferences.
tldr: Proposes a Learning from Haptics (LfH) framework that uses a differentiable Control Barrier Function optimization layer to learn personalized safety interventions for haptic human-robot shared control from sparse demonstrations.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种从触觉中学习（LfH）框架，该框架使用可微分的控制障碍函数优化层，从稀疏演示中学习个性化安全干预措施，用于触觉人机共享控制。
summary_zh: 触觉反馈为人机共享控制中安全意图的传递提供了隐式通道。现有触觉引导系统通常采用预设的干预策略，无法适应个体用户或应用场景多样化的安全偏好。为解决这一局限，我们提出了一种基于触觉学习（LfH）的框架，该框架从稀疏演示中学习用户偏好的安全干预方式，无需人工试错设计。该框架基于可微分的控制障碍函数（CBF）优化层构建，可自动调整底层安全参数以匹配演示的触觉响应。用户无需直接调节控制器参数，而是通过教学方式向系统传达其在遥操作中期望的干预方式。最终生成的触觉引导既反映了演示的干预偏好，又保留了触觉共享控制的直观交互特性。仿真与硬件实验表明，该框架能够从稀疏用户输入中学习个性化的安全干预策略，并有效减少生成触觉反馈与演示偏好之间的差异。

title: Dreamer-CPC: Message Learning with World Models for Decentralized Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: In multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), inter-agent communication is effective for improving performance under partial observability. Representation learning-based approaches enable decentralized agents to learn messages grounded in their own observations, but they rely only on current observations and cannot convey information accumulated over time. We propose Dreamer-CPC, a decentralized model-based MARL method that integrates message learning based on Collective Predictive Coding (CPC) into the world model of DreamerV3. Each agent independently maintains a world model and a message module, and infers and exchanges messages from the latent states of the world model that reflect the history of past observations and actions. We evaluated Dreamer-CPC in two environments: Observer, a non-cooperative information-sharing task, and CatchApple, a newly introduced task in which task-relevant observations are temporarily missing. In both environments, Dreamer-CPC outperformed IPPO-CPC, an existing CPC-based method that generates messages from current observations, as well as no-communication baselines. In particular, in CatchApple, Dreamer-CPC achieved 4 to 5 times the episode return of IPPO-CPC, demonstrating effective coordination where other methods fail due to missing observations. These results suggest that communication grounded in the latent dynamics of world models can support decentralized decision-making when current observations alone are insufficient.
tldr: Dreamer-CPC integrates Collective Predictive Coding (CPC) message learning into DreamerV3's world model for decentralized multi-agent RL, enabling agents to share latent state histories and significantly outperforming baselines in tasks with missing observations.
tldr_zh: Dreamer-CPC 将集体预测编码（CPC）消息学习整合到 DreamerV3 的世界模型中，用于分散式多智能体强化学习，使智能体能够共享潜在状态历史，在观测缺失的任务中显著优于基线方法。
summary_zh: 在多智能体强化学习（MARL）中，智能体间的通信在部分可观测条件下能有效提升性能。基于表示学习的方法使分散式智能体能够学习基于自身观测的消息，但这些方法仅依赖当前观测，无法传递随时间累积的信息。我们提出Dreamer-CPC，一种基于模型的分散式MARL方法，将基于集体预测编码（CPC）的消息学习整合到DreamerV3的世界模型中。每个智能体独立维护一个世界模型和一个消息模块，并从反映历史观测与动作序列的世界模型潜状态中推断并交换消息。我们在两个环境中评估了Dreamer-CPC：非合作信息共享任务Observer与新引入的CatchApple任务——该任务中与任务相关的观测会暂时缺失。在这两个环境中，Dreamer-CPC均优于现有基于CPC的方法IPPO-CPC（从当前观测生成消息）以及无通信基线。特别地，在CatchApple任务中，Dreamer-CPC获得的回合回报是IPPO-CPC的4至5倍，展现了当其他方法因观测缺失而失败时的有效协调能力。这些结果表明，当仅凭当前观测不足时，基于世界模型潜动态的通信能够支撑分散式决策。

title: The World Model Remembers, the Actor Forgets: Dream Rehearsal for Continual Model-Based RL
summary: Model-based reinforcement-learning agents of the DreamerV3 family forget catastrophically when trained on task sequences, even when an unbounded replay buffer preserves every earlier experience. We ask a question the continual-RL literature has assumed an answer to but never measured: which component forgets? Under never-clear replay, pre-registered component-level probes (n=3 seeds throughout) show that the world model retains essentially everything measurable about old tasks -- reward discrimination (retention ratio ~1.0), value estimates, and termination structure -- while the actor's behavior collapses. Forgetting in this regime is a channel problem, not a memory problem. We demonstrate this by intervention: with the world model frozen and identical imagined rollouts, reinforcement learning in imagination fails to recover a lost skill (0/3 seeds), while supervised self-imitation on the world model's own graded dreams recovers it on 3/3 seeds with zero environment interaction. Interleaved during training, this graded dream rehearsal yields a task-label-free, parameter-constant continual learner: 3/3 four-task chains retained where plain replay passes 0/3, 3/3 eight-task chains, and consistent gains over matched real-episode cloning (paired difference +0.13, bootstrap 95% CI [0.07, 0.24], complete seed separation). The dream-grading step is load-bearing: we characterize two scoring failure modes, provide an offline selection gauge that caught both before they contaminated results, and give a realized-first grading rule that closes them. All experiments were pre-registered with committed protocols; every refuted hypothesis is reported.
tldr: This paper identifies that in continual model-based RL (DreamerV3), catastrophic forgetting originates from the actor's policy collapse, not the world model's memory, and proposes 'graded dream rehearsal'—a self-imitation method using the frozen world model's own graded dreams—to achieve continual learning without task labels or parameter growth.
tldr_zh: 本文发现在持续模型强化学习（DreamerV3）中，灾难性遗忘源于策略（actor）的崩溃而非世界模型的记忆丢失，并提出‘分级梦境排练’——利用冻结的世界模型自身的分级梦境进行自我模仿——实现了无需任务标签或参数增长的持续学习。
summary_zh: DreamerV3系列基于模型的强化学习智能体在任务序列训练中会出现灾难性遗忘，即便采用无界回放缓冲区保留所有早期经验。我们提出了持续强化学习文献虽有预设答案却从未量化的问题：究竟是哪个组件发生遗忘？在不清空回放的情况下，预注册的组件级探测（全程n=3个种子）表明：世界模型基本上保留了关于旧任务的所有可测量信息——奖励判别（保留率~1.0）、价值估计和终止结构——而行动者的行为却崩溃了。该情境下的遗忘是通道问题而非记忆问题。我们通过干预验证了这一点：冻结世界模型并使用相同的想象轨迹，基于想象的强化学习无法恢复已丢失技能（0/3个种子），而基于世界模型自身分级梦境的有监督自我模仿在零环境交互条件下成功恢复（3/3个种子）。在训练过程中交错进行这种分级梦境演练，可构建出无需任务标签、参数恒定的持续学习器：四任务链保留率3/3（纯回放通过率0/3）、八任务链保留率3/3，且相较于匹配的真实情节克隆方法具有一致优势（配对差异+0.13，bootstrap 95% CI [0.07, 0.24]，完全种子分离）。梦境分级步骤具有关键支撑作用：我们表征了两种评分失效模式，提供了离线选择标尺（在污染结果前即可捕获两者），并提出了可消除这些缺陷的实操优先分级规则。所有实验均采用承诺协议预注册，报告了所有被推翻的假设。

title: Clinical Pathways as Safety Specifications for Physical AI in Hospital Wards
summary: Ensuring safety in Physical AI systems operating in real-world environments is a critical challenge, particularly in hospital wards where vulnerable patients, clinical staff, medical devices, and assistive robots coexist. In this paper, we reinterpret Clinical Pathways as explicit runtime safety specifications for embodied medical AI. We propose a conceptual robotic architecture that integrates wearable sensors, smart medical devices, and assistive robotic components into a unified framework for real-time safety monitoring. At its core, a Runtime Safety Monitor (RSM) evaluates multimodal physiological and system-level signals against clinically defined constraints derived from the prescribed care process. Rather than relying solely on statistical anomaly detection, the proposed approach combines temporal prediction, uncertainty-aware reasoning, and constraint-based verification to identify safety violations. The RSM targets three classes of events: physiological deviations from prescribed care, hardware and communication failures, and potential data tampering or misuse. This work contributes to Safe Physical AI by operationalizing domain-specific clinical knowledge as enforceable safety constraints, bridging learning-based perception and runtime safety monitoring to assist nursing staff in real-world hospital wards.
tldr: This paper proposes using clinical pathways as runtime safety specifications to monitor the behavior of embodied medical AI, including assistive robots, in hospital wards, combining sensor data and constraint-based verification to detect safety violations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出将临床路径作为运行时安全规范，用于监控医院病房中具身医疗AI（包括辅助机器人）的行为，结合传感器数据和基于约束的验证来检测安全违规。

title: Courteous Anticipation: Improving Long-Lived Task Planning in Persistent Shared Environments
summary: We consider a task planning scenario in which robots sharing a persistent environment are assigned tasks one at a time from a held-out sequence. Standard task planners, lacking foresight of future tasks and inconsiderate of others' constraints, solve each task in isolation, leaving terminal states that increase future cost for all, side effects that compound over lengthy task sequences. To reduce cost over the sequence, a robot must anticipate how its actions now may impact performance on future tasks for all robots sharing the environment. Therefore, we present courteous anticipatory planning, wherein a model-based planner proposes candidate plans and selects the one that jointly minimizes immediate cost and aggregated expected future cost across all robots, estimated via independent per-robot learned estimators. This factored formulation avoids combinatorial joint rollouts and supports modular deployment: adding a robot requires only training its own estimator. We evaluate in two persistent PDDL domains, a home environment with robots that have similar capabilities but different responsibilities, and a restaurant environment where robots' distinct capabilities create states that other robots lack the capability to resolve.
